metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to quickly relieve groin pain.

A primary cause of inner thigh and groin pain is a combination of muscle weakness and tightness, particularly in the iliopsoas and adductor muscle groups.

This video provides an easy-to-follow, step-by-step guide focusing on lengthening and strengthening these muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief.

For the best results, complete all the exercises and focus on those that offer the most relief.

Watch now for instant groin pain relief!
